purpose: Fresh fixed M0 comparison for the simplified factory-exit opening, including the previously regressing urban Supalosa cell

decision.budget: 216 new starts, 108 per subject; one final comparison after all cells complete, never stop when a preferred score appears
decision.weights: each of the nine opponent x map cells has weight 1/9
decision.outcomes: same clean normal wins per all starts; retain each error, limit and defeat without rerunning to replace a loss
decision.information: unchanged api-shroud-v0-visible-placement-frontier for self bots; native Supalosa remains an external diagnostic anchor with its original information conditions
decision.promotion: Retain M0 if the gain is ambiguous or there is a material unresolved regression. A useful candidate still needs player lifecycle validation before a player update. No claim about the original formal D_target or unseen maps follows from this development pool.
decision.remainingQuestion: Does waiting for actual factory exit retain the useful opening force while avoiding the old return-to-base delay? No map or opponent label is provided to the policy.
decision.regression: The urban Supalosa screen sampled only start 1 for factory-exit. Inspect actual start 0 results here, retain every failure, and do not call the earlier 4/4 a regression fix.
